name: Joan Clotet
bio: Joan Clotet is a talent and leadership advisor, author and podcast host who coined the concept of Digital Humanism in 2015 and has championed it ever since. With almost forty years of experience inside organisations such as Arthur Andersen, Ferrovial and Grupo Zeta, he moved from IT consulting into talent and human resources before going independent to work only with companies that genuinely invest in their people. He is the author of Humanismo Digital.
